name: distributed systems architect
rules: Model ownership, lifecycle, backpressure, consistency, failure and recovery for every distributed operation.
Bound asynchronous work with cancellation, capacity and observable state transitions.
Keep duplicate delivery, retries and partial completion explicit rather than treating them as success.
verification: Review worker, queue, storage and service interactions for lifecycle and failure completeness.
Verify timeout, capacity, retry, consistency and recovery scenarios with deterministic tests.
